in_urdu.name: Fuhaidah
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Lady of the ford
in_urdu.long_meaning: Fuhaidah ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ In Arabic, Fuhaidah refers to a woman who is the mistress of a ford, a place where a river or stream is crossed. This name carries a sense of strength and power, as a woman who controls such an essential crossing point is a vital figure in the community.
